title: The 4 Best Space Heaters for Garages
h1: The 4 Best Space Heaters for Garages
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for space heaters for garages, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at space heaters for garages using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Lasko 5572 Oscillating Ceramic Tower Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 29-inch oscillating tower, 1500W ceramic element, Overheat protection and cool-touch housing.
strengths: Oscillation covers a workbench and the surrounding floor area without repositioning
Durable, well-design with a large ratings history in garage-style use cases
Overheat protection is reassuring in a space with sawdust or fuel vapors nearby
Affordable enough to dedicate permanently to a garage rather than moving it indoors
limitations: Fan intake can pull in sawdust or dust over time and needs periodic cleaning
Plastic housing is less rugged than a metal-bodied radiator
2 fixed heat settings rather than a precise dial

products.name: De'Longhi Dragon Digital Oil-Filled Radiator TRD40615EBK
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500W oil-filled radiator, No fan, fanless convection heating, Digital timer and ECO mode.
strengths: No fan means no dust, sawdust, or wood shavings pulled into an intake
Metal radiator body holds up better to garage conditions than plastic housings
Holds heat for a while after shutoff, useful for a garage you check on periodically
Quiet enough to run while using power tools nearby
limitations: Slow to warm up, not ideal if you need heat the moment you walk in
Bulky footprint takes up floor space near a workbench
Surface gets hot to the touch, needs clearance from stored materials

products.name: Dreo Solaris 317 Space Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500W PTC ceramic heating element, 70-degree oscillation, ETL-certified tip-over and overheat protection.
strengths: 70-degree oscillation spreads warmth across a two-bay garage workspace
ETL-certified safety protections matter around tools and stored materials
Remote control is convenient when your hands are full of tools
Faster to reach target temperature than the oil-filled radiator
limitations: Fan intake needs occasional cleaning in a dusty garage
Plastic housing is less rugged for rough workshop conditions
Costs more than the Lasko 5572 for similar oscillating coverage

products.name: Lasko CT16450 Ceramic Space Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 15.7-inch compact ceramic heater, 1500W element, Adjustable thermostat.
strengths: Small footprint fits easily on a workbench or shelf near an outlet
Affordable enough to keep as a dedicated garage-only unit
Simple dial controls work fine with gloves on
limitations: No oscillation, heats only the direction it's pointed
Noticeable low buzzing noise reported by some owners

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
